audit.finding: PowerPyx (20 Nov) publishes methods for In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Ten Pin and The Truth Is Out There. This guide follows the newer source and names the older one beside each trophy.
audit.topic: Four trophies GTA Zone (18 Nov) called unconfirmed now have methods

audit.finding: No guide has a confirmed method as of 20 Nov. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. This guide says so plainly instead of guessing.
audit.topic: Bad Luck, I Guess is still unknown

audit.finding: PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, but the early meditation is not marked as a spot in the progress menu, so it is unproven whether it counts. This guide marks the trophy disputed and tells you to do the meditation anyway.
audit.topic: Positive Mental Attitude: is the Chapter 1 meditation required?

audit.finding: PowerPyx confirms the Bret questline and the rifle, but not which animal pops the trophy. This guide marks it disputed.

Rockstar has not published an official list. Names, descriptions and grades are the ones PowerPyx, GTABase, GTA Zone and PSNProfiles agree on; the counts (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden) match across all of them.
audit.topic: The trophy list itself is not from Rockstar

roadmap.cheats: Using a cheat disables trophies and saving for the session. All 61 cheats unlock only after the story.
roadmap.saves: 15 manual save slots + 1 autosave. No mission replay, so keep a save at the start and end of each chapter.

stages.text: Play the five chapters, take optional missions as they appear, scan vehicles and study animals on the way. The 100% checklist is not viewable yet, but progress already counts. Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house — it is the one thing that can go away.
stages.title: Story, five chapters

stages.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list. It is closer to 60% of true completion: most thresholds are partial (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges), and only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything.
stages.title: 100% checklist + challenges

stages.text: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count, the character questlines, and whatever miscellaneous trophies are left. Most of them pop on the way through stage 2.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing else counts toward it — no DLC, no online mode, no difficulty setting. It lands the moment the 54th trophy does.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as the story plays out; there is nothing extra to do beyond the mission itself.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. A story trophy, unmissable — it pops with the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. A story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy, unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story — but progress made during the story already counts. The bar is lenient, roughly 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions and 300 of 397 stunts. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable; all of it can be finished in free roam. This is the hardest trophy on the list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (300 are needed for 100%). Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like. Under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt keeps its own name.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check the list under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most of these happen naturally while chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The medals are not considered hard, and no other shooting-range result counts toward the trophy.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total; all 42 are needed for 100%). One win per location is enough for the trophy.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, out of 40 unique race locations. Winning the same race twice does not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there and take the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish every level at least once; bonus challenges are not required. Four games exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the map. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and marks itself automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His line marks itself in Chapter 1: after the mission Island Dreams he calls and appears as a green “KR” icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch of the story and returns in Chapter 2–3, so the line cannot be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His line marks itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. All stay open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain lines count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Track the count in the trophy list; every strand stays open after the story in free roam.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His Wish List marks itself after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green “RK” icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, then drive it back — a car in good condition pays more. The list is still open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Jason-only. His line marks itself after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point at Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and Tyrone then hands you Spin On This. Still open after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as +2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The catch: one early meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 can only be done in that chapter — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is not yet confirmed whether that one is required for the trophy; PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, so the early one cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.note: Disputed: it is unproven whether the Chapter 1 meditation counts toward the trophy.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His line is Jason-only and marks itself after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — Bret texts you about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His first quest hands you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed; his 15 Target Decks are all needed for 100%, so work through them and the trophy should follow.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.note: Disputed: the exact animal that pops the trophy is unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets, out of 18 sets in the game. Sets are found around the map; PowerPyx links a guide to all 18 set locations.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations — any mix counts. The pool is 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan by holding up on the D-pad, then R1, while looking at the object.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges (70 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way). View them under Progress > Challenges; the checkmark at the bottom right shows which are done. Most complete naturally; save the easiest ones for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Build 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy escape, since cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault jobs always bring 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while the wanted level stays flashing red and blue. Wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and keep your partner with you. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well — they open after Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The game has 557 at launch; scan them with the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad, then R1) — standing on a busy road and scanning traffic is the fastest way. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so this pops on the way. Check counts under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Eat, drink or use Adrenaline first to extend it, wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies — gang operations are a good spot — then drop them fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest, reached by driving through a fence and up the stairs by the boarding bridge. Board, climb to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. Planes parked on the open airfield do not count; it must be docked to a bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to unlock the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. It pops shortly after you leave.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (8 exist; all 8 are needed for 100%). Vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and grab the cash — bring your partner, since you cannot carry it all. After that, Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 a tip. Every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready; a single vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… does it for you — tailing the truck to a bank vault counts. Earlier option: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. Flying a plane over the fogged areas is the fastest way.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist; all 39 are needed for 100%). Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many mark themselves from story progress. Track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar. GTA Zone's 18 Nov list still had this one unconfirmed; PowerPyx's 20 Nov guide gives the method above.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.note: GTA Zone (18 Nov) listed this as unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) gives the method.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only that blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. GTA Zone's 18 Nov list still had this one unconfirmed; PowerPyx's 20 Nov guide gives the method above.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.note: GTA Zone (18 Nov) listed this as unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) gives the method.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — it marks itself during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (sticky bombs open it). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can switch between them. Work out at a fitness club — always bring your partner along (hold right on the D-pad, press triangle), since the idle character trains automatically while the other works out. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — robberies, escapes and enemy encounters all count; the trophy list itself shows your count. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see each action land. It builds passively; if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops — but avoid pushing your profile to Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No guide has a confirmed method as of 20 Nov — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Do not chase a rumoured method; this entry will be updated when a guide pins it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.note: Unconfirmed: no guide has a method yet. Believed to involve the Payday Loans store.

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, alone, drive the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and return. Follow the path into the woods from the car and a UFO appears; approach it, and it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside. GTA Zone's 18 Nov list still had this one unconfirmed; PowerPyx's 20 Nov guide gives the method above.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: GTA Zone (18 Nov) listed this as unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) gives the method.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — crowded spots like Vice City or Ocean Beach work best. GTA Zone's 18 Nov list still had this one unconfirmed; PowerPyx's 20 Nov guide gives the method above.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.note: GTA Zone (18 Nov) listed this as unconfirmed; PowerPyx (20 Nov) gives the method.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total across all robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while doing the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it. The map holds 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties ($160,000 in total). Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to raise the cash.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register in his garage. You need free garage space first — see Little Boxes. Early on he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
